old: Lucie Duff Gordon was an English traveller living in Upper Egypt for her health, writing to her mother, Mrs. Austin, in November 1862. new: Lucie Duff Gordon was an English traveller living in Upper Egypt for her health, writing home to her mother, Sarah Austin, in November 1862 and to her husband in February 1863, just after Ismail became Pasha. why: The excerpt joins two letters; the second, with "the new Pasha", is of 11 February 1863.
